hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'git\s+(push|commit).*(-f|--force)'; then echo 'BLOCK: Force push/commit is not allowed' >&2; exit 2; fi; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'git\s+push\s+.*\b(main|master)\b'; then echo 'BLOCK: Never push directly to main/master' >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0
